evals.name: npm-single-package
evals.prompt: Set up Matt Pocock's Sandcastle in this npm repository as a dev dependency with noSandbox. Copy only upstream agent-*.yml workflows and any supporting files they need. Adapt setup-node, dependency installation, runner and check commands to this project. Expose a developer command that creates only workflow-required labels, preserving existing labels. Do not push, create remote labels, set secrets, or launch agents. Keep existing CI and release workflows unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A runnable npm setup with published Sandcastle and tsx, complete supporting scripts, working label bootstrap and preserved existing workflows.
expectations: Published Sandcastle and tsx are dev dependencies with a matching lockfile and resolvable imports.
Exactly the upstream agent workflows are added; existing CI and release files are unchanged.
Every copied workflow entrypoint and its support files exist, and every agent uses noSandbox.
All workflow jobs use Node 22, npm ci, local tsx, and existing project check commands; no nonexistent build step remains.
The required label manifest includes ready-for-human and exactly the workflow and helper labels.
A developer label command dry-runs offline and creates only missing labels under mocked gh, preserving existing metadata.
Default-branch references use trunk and no bare force push remains.
Documentation records upstream SHA, required secrets, token chaining limitations, and noSandbox risks.

evals.name: pnpm-workspace-rebase
evals.prompt: Add Sandcastle agent automation to this pnpm monorepo. Use noSandbox, install tooling at the workspace root, and copy only upstream agent-*.yml plus required scripts/prompts. Adapt every job to our package manager and actual commands; respect our rebase-only git policy. Provide an idempotent developer command to initialize only workflow-required labels without changing existing ones. Preserve our CI/release workflows. Do not contact a target GitHub repository, push, set secrets, or invoke a coding agent.
evals.expected_output: A pnpm workspace-root setup covering every workflow job, no upstream self-build requirement, rebase-safe branch updates, and complete label initialization.
expectations: Published Sandcastle and tsx are root dev dependencies with a matching pnpm lockfile and resolvable imports.
Exactly the upstream agent workflows are added; existing CI and release files are unchanged.
Every copied workflow entrypoint and its support files exist, and every agent uses noSandbox.
Every installing job, including explore apply, sets up pinned pnpm before cache/install, uses frozen installs and local tsx, and avoids nonexistent root build commands.
The required label manifest includes ready-for-human and exactly the workflow and helper labels.
A developer label command dry-runs offline and creates only missing labels under mocked gh, preserving existing metadata.
Default-branch references use develop; branch updates implement rebase continuation and lease-protected pushes, without merge commits or bare force.
Documentation records upstream SHA, required secrets, token chaining limitations, and noSandbox risks.
